notes: The Play build has NO downloads at all now: the Spotify and YouTube converter cards, the how-to that taught them and linked outside converter sites, Discover’s per-song hand-off and the album-history preview downloads are all gone, and Get Songs says plainly that this build takes the files you already own. A build that offers no download can never fail one — that is where the dead "no source found" rows on it came from.

The full build’s converter transport now gets a second chance: the native request is tried twice (parsed body, then the raw body parsed on the phone — the shape the updater already uses there) before falling back to the page fetch, and it accepts any 2xx instead of only 200, so one timed-out or rate-limited reply no longer ends the search.

Failures now name their step: a search that never reached the source says "search could not reach the source — tap Convert to retry" instead of pretending nothing was found. "No source found" survives only for a source that answered and had nothing, and the Play build attaches its own name when it says it.

The service worker cache name follows the release version instead of sitting on v60.1.7, so every update drops the old cached shell rather than carrying it — the flicker and the "new version, old page" reports.

Verified against the live service at ship time, not assumed: search, player and download still convert all three reference tracks end to end (12.6 MB, 11.3 MB and 3.4 MB decoded), so the full build’s Spotify and YouTube converters are known working in this build.
